function envoy_on_request(request_handle)
  -- 1. Get XFCC Header
  local xfcc_val = request_handle:headers():get("x-forwarded-client-cert")
  if xfcc_val == nil or xfcc_val == "" then
    -- XFCC header is not found, skip extraction.
    return
  end

  -- 2. Get the first element before comma
  local xfcc_origin_element = xfcc_val:match("([^,]+)")
  if xfcc_origin_element == nil or xfcc_origin_element == "" then
    return
  end

  -- 3. Loop over elements split by ";"
  -- We need to manually iterate to mimic split and validation
  local start_idx = 1
  local len = #xfcc_origin_element
  while start_idx <= len do
    local end_idx = string.find(xfcc_origin_element, ";", start_idx)
    local element
    if end_idx == nil then
      element = string.sub(xfcc_origin_element, start_idx)
      start_idx = len + 1
    else
      element = string.sub(xfcc_origin_element, start_idx, end_idx - 1)
      start_idx = end_idx + 1
    end

    -- 4. Check if element starts with "URI="
    if string.sub(element, 1, 4) == "URI=" then
        local value = string.sub(element, 5)
        if value ~= nil and value ~= "" then
          request_handle:headers():replace("x-peer-client-identity", value)
        end
        return
    end
  end
  request_handle:logCritical("failed to parse xfcc header elements")
end
